name: COSINE
summary: COSINE combines the KIMS and DM-Ice teams to test DAMA/LIBRA's annual modulation with NaI(Tl). COSINE-100 operated at Yangyang; the upgraded and larger phases move to Yemilab.
detection_principle: A NaI(Tl) array is surrounded by a liquid-scintillator anticoincidence system. Multiyear low-energy single-hit rates and energy spectra are used for dark-matter searches, with reduced crystal backgrounds such as potassium.

results.summary: The full-dataset annual-modulation result challenges the dark-matter interpretation of DAMA/LIBRA.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
